一、太白升仙·情缘难续
时空折跃阵的光芒在剑谷中逐渐暗淡。
沈轻烟面色苍白，额间渗出细汗——维持这个跨越千里的传送阵六个时辰，几乎耗尽了她所有时空灵力。但值得欣慰的是，阵法另一端的长安坐标已经稳定。
李太白站在阵眼处，青衫无风自动。他看了一眼祁连山的夜空，那里，太白金星正散发着前所未有的明亮光芒。
“时辰到了。”他轻声道。
话音未落，夜空中的金星突然爆发出一道通天彻地的金色光柱，直射剑谷！光柱所过之处，云层退散，星辰失色，整个祁连山脉都被镀上一层神圣的金辉。
“这是……”废焰老祖瞳孔收缩。
“天庭接引之光。”李太白平静道，“三百年人间游历，今日功德圆满，该归位了。”
众人这才想起——李太白本就不是凡人，他是太白金星在人间的一缕分魂转世，诗剑双绝三百年，如今劫满归真。
惜若手中的酒杯“啪”地落地，酒水洒了一地。她怔怔地看着李太白，嘴唇微颤：“前辈……您要走？”
李太白转身看向她：“小若，仙凡有别，这是天命。我留在人间的时间，本就已经不多了。”
“可是……”惜若想说很多话，想说她才刚得到他的传承，想说她还有很多剑招没学会，想说……她心里那股说不清道不明的情愫，才刚刚萌芽。
但千言万语堵在喉咙，最终只化作一句哽咽：“什么时候……还能再见？”
李太白轻轻摇头：“天庭有律，仙人不可随意插手凡间因果。此去一别，恐难再见。”
金色的接引光柱越来越亮，李太白的身体开始变得透明，有无数金色的光点从身上飘散。他的声音也缥缈起来：“惜若，你记住——我传你的《太白剑经》共分九重，你如今只到第三重。待你修至第九重‘诗剑合道’之境，或许……还有一线机缘。”
他顿了顿，忽然抬手，指尖点在惜若眉心：
“这最后一式‘青莲剑歌’，我现在传你。此剑歌蕴我三百年剑道精华，你需用心感悟。将来若遇大劫，此式可救你一命。”
庞大的信息流涌入惜若识海，那是一首剑歌，也是一幅剑图，更是一种境界。她感觉自己仿佛化作了月下独酌的诗人，又仿佛成了仗剑天涯的侠客，最后又成了那柄刺破苍穹的剑。
等她回过神时，李太白的身影已几近透明。

“诸位——”李太白环视众人，“九幽阁之劫，关乎天下苍生。我虽不能直接出手，但临行前，可助你们一臂之力。”
他抬手，三道金光分别射向杨思纯、江流云、胡嗖：
“杨小友，你身为盟主有着无比坚韧的信仰，体内金水相济已有雏形，这道‘太白金气’可助你稳固根基，将来或可走出一条前所未有的五行大道。”
“江小友，你擅隐流之术，这道金气可炼入你的时空法宝，关键时刻能破开幽冥子的空间封锁。”
“胡小友……你我虽只一面之缘，但诗书相交，已成知己。这道金气或许能助你找到仙逝的道侣。”
三人同时感到一股精纯无比的金灵之力融入体内，修为瓶颈都隐隐有松动之感。
最后，李太白看向废焰老祖、霓依及五子：“祁连山一战，凶险万分。我在剑谷地下留了一座‘斩龙剑阵’，阵眼是当年斩龙剑的残骸。若九幽阁来袭，可引他们入阵……”
话未说完，接引光柱猛地一收！
李太白的身影化作无数金色光点，向夜空中的金星飞去。在他完全消失前，众人仿佛听到一声若有若无的叹息：
“人间……”
金星光芒渐渐恢复正常。
一代诗仙，就此归位。
剑谷中一片寂静，只有山风吹过古松的沙沙声。
惜若呆呆地望着夜空，泪水无声滑落。她手中还握着李太白刚才用过的酒杯，杯沿似乎还残留着他的温度。
胡嗖走到她身边，想安慰几句，却不知如何开口。他懂这种心情——当年道侣离去时，他也是这般，感觉整个天地都空了。
最后是永珍轻轻揽住惜若的肩膀：“想哭就哭吧。”
惜若咬着嘴唇，重重点头。她擦干眼泪，忽然握紧腰间佩剑——那是李太白随手炼制的“秋水剑”，剑身如一泓秋水，如今却隐隐泛着金光。
“我会修到第九重。”她声音不大，却异常坚定，“一定会。”
二、长安劫起·太真观变
时空折跃阵再次亮起时，杨思纯、永珍、惜若三人已站在长安城西郊的一处荒宅中。

按照计划，李太白本该与他们同行。但如今太白升仙，救杨暄的重担，就完全落在了他们肩上。
“时辰不多了。”杨思纯看向东方天际——那里已泛起鱼肚白，“李林甫将杨暄送入太真观的时间提前到了今日辰时，现在已近卯时三刻。”

1. Taibai ascends to immortality·Love is difficult to continue
The light of the space-time folding array gradually dimmed in the Sword Valley.
Shen Qingyan's face was pale, and thin sweat broke out on her forehead - maintaining this teleportation array spanning thousands of miles for six hours almost exhausted all her time and space spiritual energy. But what is gratifying is that the coordinates of Chang'an on the other side of the formation have stabilized.
Li Taibai stood at the center of the formation, wearing a green shirt without any wind. He glanced at the night sky in the Qilian Mountains, where the Taibai Venus was emitting unprecedented bright light.
"The time has come," he said softly.
Before he finished speaking, Venus in the night sky suddenly erupted into a golden beam of light that penetrated the sky and the earth, shooting straight into the Sword Valley! Wherever the light beam passes, the clouds recede, the stars lose their color, and the entire Qilian Mountains are coated with a layer of sacred golden light.
"This is..." Ancestor Feiyan's pupils shrank.
"Heaven receives the light." Li Taibai said calmly, "Three hundred years of traveling in the human world. Today, my merits have been fulfilled. It's time to return to my place."
Only then did everyone remember that Li Taibai was not a mortal in the first place. He was the reincarnation of the soul of Taibai Venus in the human world. He had mastered poetry and swords for three hundred years, and now he has returned to his true form.
The wine glass in Xiruo's hand fell to the ground with a bang, and the wine spilled all over the floor. She looked at Li Taibai blankly, her lips trembling slightly: "Senior...you want to leave?"
Li Taibai turned to look at her: "Xiao Ruo, there is a difference between immortals and mortals. This is destiny. My time to stay in the world is already running out."
"But..." Xiruo wanted to say a lot, she wanted to say that she had just received his inheritance, she wanted to say that she still had many sword moves to learn, she wanted to say... that the indescribable emotion in her heart had just sprouted.
But thousands of words were stuck in my throat, and in the end they turned into a choked sob: "When... can we see you again?"
Li Taibai shook his head gently: "There are laws in heaven, and immortals cannot meddle in the cause and effect of the mortal world at will. If we say goodbye now, I may never see you again."
The golden light beam became brighter and brighter, and Li Taibai's body began to become transparent, with countless golden light spots floating away from his body. His voice also became ethereal: "Xi Ruo, please remember - the "Taibai Sword Sutra" I taught you is divided into nine levels, and you are only at the third level now. When you reach the ninth level of 'Poem and Sword Harmony', maybe... there will be a chance."
He paused, then suddenly raised his hand, his fingertips touching Xiruo's eyebrows:
"This last move, 'Green Lotus Sword Song', I will teach you now. This sword song contains the essence of my three hundred years of swordsmanship, and you need to understand it with your heart. If you encounter a catastrophe in the future, this move can save your life."
A huge flow of information pours into Xiruo Consciousness Sea. It is a sword song, a sword picture, and a state. She felt as if she had turned into a poet drinking alone under the moon, then as a knight wielding a sword across the world, and finally as the sword that pierced the sky.
When she came to her senses, Li Taibai's figure was almost transparent.
"Everyone -" Li Taibai looked around at everyone, "The disaster of Jiuyou Pavilion is related to everyone in the world. Although I can't take action directly, I can help you before leaving."
He raised his hand, and three golden lights shot at Yang Sichun, Jiang Liuyun, and Hu Sou respectively:
"Young friend Yang, as the leader of the alliance, you have extremely tenacious beliefs. The combination of gold and water in your body has already taken shape. This 'taibai gold energy' can help you solidify your foundation. In the future, you may be able to embark on an unprecedented five-element path."
"Little friend Jiang, you are good at the art of hidden flow. This golden energy can be refined into your space-time magic weapon, and it can break the space blockade of You Mingzi at critical moments."
"Little friend Hu... Although you and I only met each other once, we have become close friends through poetry and books. This golden energy may help you find your deceased Taoist companion."
The three of them simultaneously felt an incomparably pure golden spirit power integrating into their bodies, and their cultivation bottlenecks felt as if they were loosening.
Finally, Li Taibai looked at Ancestor Fei Yan, Ni Yi and the Fifth Son: "The battle in Qilian Mountain is extremely dangerous. I left a 'Dragon-Slaying Sword Formation' underground in the Sword Valley. The center of the formation is the remains of the Dragon-Slaying Sword. If Jiuyou Pavilion attacks, we can lure them into the formation..."Before he finished speaking, the light beam suddenly retracted!
Li Taibai's figure turned into countless golden light spots and flew towards Venus in the night sky. Before he disappeared completely, everyone seemed to hear a vague sigh:
"The human world..."
The light of Venus gradually returned to normal.
A generation of poetry immortals has returned to his throne.
There was silence in the Sword Valley, except for the rustle of the ancient pines in the mountain wind.
Xiruo stared blankly at the night sky, tears falling silently. She still held the wine glass that Li Taibai had just used in her hand, and his warmth seemed to still remain on the rim of the glass.
Hu Sou walked to her side and wanted to comfort her with a few words, but didn't know how to speak. He understands this feeling - when the Taoist companion left, he felt the same way, feeling that the whole world was empty.
In the end, Yongzhen gently held Xiruo's shoulders: "Cry if you want to."
Xiruo bit her lip and nodded heavily. She wiped away her tears and suddenly tightened her grip on the sword at her waist - it was the "Autumn Water Sword" that Li Taibai had casually refined. The sword's body was like a stream of autumn water, but now it was faintly glowing with golden light.
"I will cultivate to the ninth level." Her voice was low but extremely firm, "I will definitely do it."
2. Chang’an robbery·Taizhen observation changes
When the space-time warping array lit up again, Yang Sichun, Yongzhen, and Xiruo were already standing in an abandoned house on the western outskirts of Chang'an City.
According to the plan, Li Taibai was supposed to go with them. But now that Taibai has ascended to immortality, the burden of saving Yang Xuan falls entirely on their shoulders.
"The time is running out." Yang Sichun looked at the eastern sky - where the fish belly was already turning white, "Li Linfu has advanced the time to send Yang Xuan to Taizhen Temple to today's hour, and it is now nearly three quarters past nine o'clock."
